title: Witness Ed contacts Greer over suppressed zero-point energy

tellings.quote:
Well, that's what Ed witness Ed out of
Edward said part of the reason he
reached out to Greer is because zero
point energy systems were being
harnessed and repressed.

plain: A witness known only as Ed is said to have reached out to the UFO campaigner Steven Greer because, in his words as passed on, zero-point energy systems, machines said to draw power from empty space, "were being harnessed and repressed." The online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels this as something Ed said. If true, it would mean a working new energy source was being kept from the public.
